key.name: warn-threshold
key.description: Usage percent above which bars and chips turn yellow.

key.name: crit-threshold
key.description: Usage percent above which bars and chips turn red.

key.name: hidden-chips
key.description: Provider ids whose chip is hidden from the panel; their card stays in the popover.

key.name: hidden-windows
key.summary: Usage bars hidden from the popover
key.description: Bar ids ("provider:key") whose usage bar is removed from the card.

key.name: known-windows
key.summary: Usage bars discovered at render time
key.description: Catalog the extension publishes for the preferences window; each entry is a JSON object {"p":provider,"k":key,"l":label}.

key.name: notify-enabled
key.description: Send a notification when a rate window crosses the notify thresholds, once per reset cycle.

key.name: codex-status-scope
key.description: Which status.openai.com component group the status strip tracks ('Everything' for the whole page).

key.name: claude-status-scope
key.description: Which status.claude.com component the status strip tracks ('Everything' for the whole page).
